# Lumen V2 utility fonts

The V2 handoff specifies League Gothic for large format numbers and IBM Plex Mono
for technical metadata. These are native packaged font assets; the application
does not load fonts from a network service at runtime.

Both families were obtained from Google Fonts commit
`bd8f81ddb5c74d5c8897b36ad88b440266245103` on 2026-10-12.
The unmodified SIL Open Font License texts are retained beside this document.

| Asset | Family | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `LeagueGothic-Variable.ttf` | League Gothic | `3B0E998C9A0034222394FFECDD383E6948259AD037B95555B139A217629CE1D0` |
| `IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf` | IBM Plex Mono | `6A3412F058C7D8DFD9170C41E85ADE48E5156ECB89356110CA57A0A27734AF46` |
| `IBMPlexMono-Medium.ttf` | IBM Plex Mono | `A9B4C49BB299E05B5F6C481E7FB5E78943D2793249A0C8874AB574A2D1EA6755` |

IBM reserves the font name Plex. The binaries have not been modified or renamed
internally. The local filenames do not change their internal font family names.
